# Warlock Herald

> Package: `@warlock.js/herald`

> Message bus/brokers for RabbitMQ, Kafka, and more

## Skills

- [consume-message](@warlock.js/herald/consume-message/SKILL.md): Consume messages in @warlock.js/herald; use when you need to consume message.
- [herald-basics](@warlock.js/herald/herald-basics/SKILL.md): Start here for @warlock.js/herald event publishing, consumers, request-response messaging, and configuration.
- [publish-message](@warlock.js/herald/publish-message/SKILL.md): Publish messages in @warlock.js/herald; use when you need to publish message.
- [request-and-respond](@warlock.js/herald/request-and-respond/SKILL.md): Request-response over the bus in @warlock.js/herald; use when you need to request and respond.
